# InterviewAI

> Practice English job interviews against an AI simulator bounded to a fixed scenario, then
> get rubric-based feedback (per-criterion scores, strengths, and improvement suggestions),
> not free-form AI commentary.

InterviewAI is a login-gated practice tool, not a public content site - most routes require an
account and are not meaningfully crawlable. See `/login` for entry.

## Key facts

- Interview scenarios are a fixed library (industry x seniority x question type), not
  open-ended AI-generated questions.
- Scoring is rubric-based and deterministic: fluency, relevance, vocabulary/grammar, and
  structure, each computed from the transcript text against fixed criteria - never an
  unconstrained AI judgment of the whole interview.
- Speech input/output uses the browser's Web Speech API.
